fact: MISA Zimbabwe says the national AI strategy has no direct legal force and that enforceable legal safeguards on AI are missing, with legislation still to be drafted.
source_slug: 2026-06-23 Implications of Zimbabwe’s National AI Strategy on Freedom of Expression Privacy and Access to Information

fact: The Zimbabwe Republic Police said on 25 December 2025 that the Cyber and Data Protection Act [Chapter 12:07] criminalises creating or sharing false or misleading digital content, including deepfake videos and AI-generated content that misrepresents reality.
